project.title: Reliable Causal Estimation under Latent Markov Confounding
project.central_claim: Phantom causal resolution: generated latent-state representations can leave residual confounding while optimistically inflating apparent downstream causal information.

methodology.sampling_scheme: Purged Block Cross-Fitting with Temporal Embargo (\tau = 24h)
methodology.inference_engine: Gaussian HMM Causal Filtering / Backward Smoothing

theoretical_assertions.theorem: Theorem 1: Decomposition of Omitted Regime Bias
theoretical_assertions.statement: Omitting the latent regime leaves heterogeneity and confounding components amplified by residual treatment variation.
When proxies contain no state information, distinct non-permutation regime-effect vectors can induce identical observable laws.
||theta_gamma-theta*||_2 <= C epsilon_gamma/lambda_min(J), separating proxy error from downstream task conditioning.

theoretical_assertions.theorem: Theorem 4: Leading-Order Risk Bound and Regularized Inversion
theoretical_assertions.statement: Spectral regularization trades shrinkage bias against variance amplification under weak conditioning.

theoretical_assertions.theorem: Theorem 5: Asymptotic Normality Under Dependent Purged Cross-Fitting
theoretical_assertions.statement: Under the stated mixing, rate, and training-fitted filtering assumptions, the bias-centered regularized estimator is asymptotically normal.
Under Bayesian calibration and spectral comparability, posterior entropy provides a one-sided observable surrogate for proxy error.
SATE/PATE uncertainty includes estimator, regime-occupation, and state-model covariance terms.

theoretical_assertions.theorem: Audited sensitivity proposition: posterior residual-confounding identity
theoretical_assertions.statement: In the binary residual model, bias = Delta_T Delta_g v / (Delta_T^2 v + sigma^2); the K-state analogue is a' Sigma b / (a' Sigma a + sigma^2). This is a sensitivity identity, not an identification theorem.

experiments.name: LatentRegimeBench Diagnostic Suite
experiments.description: 5 factorial configurations evaluating OR-DML vs Standard DML, Block DML, and Oracle under varied observability and regime overlap.

experiments.name: Latent Representation Zoo under Disentangled Distribution Shifts
experiments.description: Evaluates HMM, GRU, Transformer, and SSM across in-distribution, Shift A (transition dynamics), Shift B (observation noise), and Shift C (compound).

experiments.name: Representation Accuracy vs Downstream Reliability
experiments.description: Representation benchmark under compound shift; state recovery, calibration, and downstream reliability are reported separately. Post-hoc calibration is evaluated in EXP-06.

experiments.name: Multi-Horizon Prospective Downstream Failure Forecasting
experiments.description: Forecasts worst-decile downstream loss across advance lead times h in [1, 24] hours on Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, and synthetic streams.

experiments.name: Hierarchical Multi-World Fixed Effects & LOWO Cross-Validation
experiments.description: Within-world fixed-effects regressions across 15 worlds (N=60) and 15-fold Leave-One-World-Out validation proving calibration doubles out-of-world R^2.

experiments.name: Calibration Intervention (Platt / Temperature Scaling) on Representation Zoo
experiments.description: Held-out temperature-scaling intervention: ECE/NLL improve substantially for neural encoders while downstream difficulty ROC-AUC does not, showing calibration alone is insufficient.

experiments.name: Multi-City Empirical Atmospheric Exposure Study
experiments.description: Empirical evaluation on >14,000 hourly observations across Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Kolkata comparing OR-DML to Standard DML and Block DML.

experiments.name: Pre-Treatment Lead Placebo Falsification Suite
experiments.description: Pre-treatment lead placebo suite at h in {-6,-3,-1}. Delhi rejects the placebo null and is therefore interpreted as an exposure-response stress test rather than a validated dynamic causal effect; the other cities do not reject immediate lead placebos.

experiments.name: Macro Financial Regime Transfer & 3-Way Regret Abstention Policy
experiments.description: Macroeconomic interest rate and liquidity indicators (FRED) testing whether D_t guides risk-aware selective estimation, reducing regret by 98.74%.

experiments.name: Independent Factorial Representation-by-Task Reliability Validation
experiments.description: 7x7 factorial design (4,900 runs) independently manipulating controlled proxy error and post-residualization residual treatment information. The joint ratio epsilon_gamma/lambda_min(J) ranks causal error with Spearman rho=0.9955, versus 0.6260 for proxy error and 0.5209 for inverse conditioning alone.

experiments.name: Phantom Causal Resolution and Generated-State Geometry Stress Tests
experiments.description: Tests whether state ambiguity can inflate generated-state lambda_min and reduce apparent condition number relative to oracle causal geometry; interpreted as a diagnostic failure mode, not estimator superiority.

experiments.name: Residual-Confounding Law Audit and Corrected-Hourly Sensitivity
experiments.description: Verifies the residual-confounding sensitivity law, audits posterior-uncertainty misspecification, and reconstructs the true-hourly sensor sensitivity after discovery of the legacy timestamp-rounding issue.
